text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. An essential time to polish
and refine Mr. C.B.'s running even further.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks...! *gulp*
Haha, that hits the spot!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, what's next on the menu?
I'd like to work on my upper body too.
choice_data_list: Figured you'd say that, so I put together a strength routine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I knew I could count on you! Let's get right to it!

During training, we gave it our all side by side.
Once it wrapped up, however, she spent her free time as she pleased.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
~♪
Oh, there we go.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sea glass.
There's quite a bit washed up if you look around.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, found a nice piece of driftwood too.
Hehe, where did you journey from, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Pretty cool, isn't it?
Crossing the wide-open sea all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, let's head back and get ready!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I went light on lunch so I'd have room for festival food~!
I'm conquering every single stall tonight♪

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Don't forget the fireworks show afterwards either!

The horsegirls jogged off toward the training camp lodge.
Apparently, there was going to be a festival and a fireworks display tonight.

Wondering if Mr. C.B. might be interested too,
I glanced over to check on her, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That glass bottle looks like it came from abroad too.
Guess I'll check over that way next.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I found a whole bunch.
You guys look even prettier in the sunset glow.

As the sun began to dip below the horizon, the faint, distant
strains of festival music drifted through the air.
choice_data_list: Sounds like there's a festival and fireworks tonight.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll pass on that.
I'd rather stay right here and watch the sun go down.

Given her total lack of reaction to the other horsegirls' chatter,
I had a feeling she'd say that.

...I should let her do as she pleases. Roaming free
is the secret behind keeping her in peak condition, after all.

Later that night, as I was working,
the distant crackle and boom of fireworks began echoing outside.

I hadn't been particularly interested before, but hearing them go off
in person gave me an urge to see them—
choice_data_list: (Maybe I'll go take a look at the fireworks.)

text_block_list.text: Setting my work aside, I stepped outside to watch the fireworks.

Suddenly, Mr. C.B.'s face popped into my head.
Is this what it feels like to just follow your own heart, without overthinking it...?
*(thud)*

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

The dull thud of gear hitting the ground brought me back to reality.
Standing right outside the entrance was Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Were you heading out to catch the fireworks by any chance?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... By the way, what's all that gear for?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Camping gear. Mugs, a lantern, stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Decided I kinda wanted to watch the fireworks after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Funny coincidence, huh?
Wanna come along? I know the absolute best spot.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Great view, right? We're a bit far off,
but at least there's nothing blocking the horizon out here.
choice_data_list: How'd you find such a great spot?
How did you find this place?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
While watching the sunset, I spotted them setting up the fireworks.
Figured it'd be pretty nice to watch from right here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thought it sounded fun, so I went to grab my camping gear.
And right as I stepped out the front door, along you came.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, it really was total coincidence.
You should've seen the look on your face.
choice_data_list: I just never expected to run into you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Yeah... I kinda like this, y'know? Things like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No promises made, no plans laid, just purely by chance.
Crossing paths in the exact same place.
choice_data_list: I'd love it if this kept happening.
I hope we get more moments like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm sure we will.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look at how a free spirit like me
and a dreamer like you managed to cross paths in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I bet Lady Luck herself
won't be able to resist throwing a few more surprises our way.

Mr. C.B. runs however she pleases.
And as her trainer, I will keep on chasing that dream alongside her.

Spending moments together purely by happenstance like this
felt just like bumping into your best friend while traveling—

Or running into your childhood crush out on the street.
A swell of indescribable warmth and happiness welled up inside me.
